environment: Konnect control plane and Kong Identity auth server created for the run, Kong Gateway 3.16 data plane on kind; echo upstream

changes.what: Konnect control plane created for the run (the generated decK file targets an existing one)
API script: auth server and principal names made unique; ids and issuer exported for the next steps
API script, usage plans: control plane name made unique
service orders-api url http://orders.internal:8080 → lab echo upstream
openid-connect issuer https://<sub>.us.identity.konghq.com/auth/.well-known/openid-configuration → issuer of the Kong Identity auth server created by the generated API script
principal nosub: same metadata without subscriptions
principal tight: same metadata with rl_per_5s 3 and bu_rl_minute 5

checks.check: Kong Identity issues a client-credentials token (aud kong-gateway)
app → orders-api (principal metadata lists the subscription)
principal without subscriptions in its metadata → 403 (acl allow_when)
API plan limit read from principal metadata (rl_per_5s)
another principal gets its own limit from its metadata
BU plan read from principal metadata (bu_rl_minute)
